tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search actual branch-level grocery prices by a Hebrew or English product name, manufacturer, or barcode string. Returns up to 20 matching products with retailer source/fetch times and citation URLs. Free; shared fair-use limits apply. Does not check live stock or take payments.

tools.name: get_data_status
tools.description: Return the actual covered branches and the freshness of their retailer price files. In hosts with app views, this also opens the shopping list without a search term. A fresh branch needs a successful fetch within 12 hours and a source file published within 72 hours. No live-stock guarantee. Free and

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_data_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
